Who I am

About me

Hi, I'm Md Samir Islam, 20 years old — a student and freelance graphic designer based in Bangladesh. I've been working in graphic design, Facebook advertising, and video editing for over three years.

Although I'm still learning and growing, I'm a creative and disciplined person who is very dedicated and detail-oriented when it comes to work. My goal is to build a strong career in graphic design and keep improving my skills every day.
